$Comment: A guard wave a boss's fight raises before the boss: the Orbis boss template runs it in Intro when a
Variant names it as GuardWave, and the boss rises only once the wave is cleared. The shape is the
game's own blocking wave (Macro_Void_Anomaly_Wave): the wave claims Orbis_Boss_Guards_Pending
before anything spawns, and lowers it once none of its creatures is left alive, so the boss never
In order. A player comes within PlayerRange of the script's entity and Delay starts (long enough
for an arrival's intro camera to end). Then two rows of Role rise, measured from the script's
entity toward the way it faces (north for an entity placed unturned): NearCount spread evenly
across NearAngle degrees NearDistance blocks out, and FarCount across FarAngle degrees FarDistance
blocks out. Once one is seen and none of Groups is left alive within Range, the wave is done and
the boss may rise. If none is ever seen (every spot blocked), the wave lets the boss rise after
WatchSeconds, so a failed spawn never holds the fight.
Its flags and timers are named Orbis_Boss_Guards_; the template clears the flags when the fight
resets, so a wipe or a reset raises the wave again. The defaults are the Headless Horseman's normal
ride: four Jack Skeletons, one at each corner of his graveyard's fountain, whose centre stands 13
blocks north of his fight's entity. His hard ride fills the same slot with ziggfreed-common's
Zc_Wave_Chain instead, a chain of waves.

Groups.Description: NPC groups holding Role: while one of them lives within Range, the boss waits. Keep them in the fight's SweepGroups too, so a reset clears them.

PlayerRange.Description: How close to the script's entity a player must come to start the wave. Cover the arrival point to raise it as players arrive.

Delay.Description: Seconds from the first player in PlayerRange to the wave rising.

NearCount.Description: How many rise in the near row.

NearAngle.Description: Degrees the near row spreads across, centred on the way the script's entity faces.

NearDistance.Description: Blocks from the script's entity to the near row.

FarCount.Description: How many rise in the far row.

FarAngle.Description: Degrees the far row spreads across, centred on the way the script's entity faces.

FarDistance.Description: Blocks from the script's entity to the far row.

Range.Description: How far from the script's entity a living guard keeps the boss waiting. Cover the whole arena.

WatchSeconds.Description: Seconds the wave waits to see a guard before it lets the boss rise anyway.

Instructions.$Comment: Until the wave is done it holds the boss: claimed before anything spawns.
A player arrives: the wait before the wave rises starts.

Actions.$Comment: A timer starts only once in the script's life, so every wave re-arms it with TimerRestart.
Actions.Name: Orbis_Boss_Guards_Delay

Instructions.$Comment: The wait is over: both rows rise, and the watch for them starts.
None left alive (or none ever seen once the watch runs out): the wave is done and the boss may rise.
